feeds.title: Homegrown Learners
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Mary mother of a homeschooled, high schooler, a college student, and founder of the Homegrown Learner site dedicated to helping you grow your learners at home. On Homegrown Learners Blog one can find useful articles on homeschooling, lego learning, classical conversations, curriculum, and encouragement.

feeds.title: Raising Up Wild Things » Classical Conversations
feeds.description: Read posts about Classical Conversations written by Natalie. Natalie created this website to come alongside others in the journey to find adventure and creativity in everyday ordinary moments.

feeds.title: Family Style Schooling
feeds.description: My name is Betsy Strauss, a homeschooling lifestyle blogger mom of 3, learning in a multi-generational household. This website is a way to share classical education. Education is a lifelong pursuit and we do it family style.

feeds.title: Half a Hundred Acre Wood Blog
feeds.description: Half a Hundred Acre Wood is your partner in home education, Equipping and enriching families with Christ-centered, missions-focused curriculum and Charlotte Mason-inspired copy work, poetry, and picture study.

feeds.title: Life Together: Loving God and Loving Each Other
feeds.description: This blog by Andrew and Jenn focuses on the love that God shares with us and that we share. They are a classical conversation family writing several posts directly related to Classical Conversations.

feeds.title: Homeschool Story
feeds.description: Homeschool Story is the place to find resources and ideas for your little ones. We try to create things that we know will be simple for busy moms.

feeds.title: My Little Brick Schoolhouse » Classical Conversations
feeds.description: Read the posts about Classical Conversations written by My Little Brick Schoolhouse. At the My Little Brick Schoolhouse, we are a homeschooled family. Homeschooling our children had always been on the radar, I am here to share my journey, homeschooling motivation and more.
